news.title: OpenAI alums have been quietly investing from a new, potentially $100M fund
news.description: Zero Shot, a new venture capital fund with deep ties to OpenAI, is aiming to raise $100 million for its first fund. It has already written some checks.

news.title: Google quietly launched an AI dictation app that works offline
news.description: Google's new offline-first dictation app uses Gemma AI models to take on the apps like Wispr Flow.

news.title: Iran threatens ‘Stargate’ AI data centers
news.description: Iran said it will target U.S.-linked data centers with new missile strikes, as the war between the U.S. and Iran escalates.

news.title: Businesses scramble to get noticed by AI search
news.description: Firms are changing the way they present information on their websites, so they get noticed by AI.

news.title: How China fell for a lobster: What an AI assistant tells us about Beijing's ambition
news.description: The AI agent sparked a frenzy of "raising lobsters" in March, with users training the tool to suit their needs.

news.title: Meta Pauses Work With Mercor After Data Breach Puts AI Industry Secrets at Risk
news.description: Major AI labs are investigating a security incident that impacted Mercor, a leading data vendor. The incident could have exposed key data about how they train AI models.

news.title: OpenAI’s Fidji Simo Is Taking Medical Leave Amid an Executive Shake-Up
news.description: The company is undergoing major leadership restructuring as its CEO of AGI deployment goes on leave for “several weeks.”
